mechanism_claims.claim_text: LTX-315 has direct rapid lytic/cytotoxic activity against melanoma cells in vitro, consistent with a membrane-disruptive anticancer peptide mechanism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper supports rapid lytic cytotoxicity and membrane-disruption framing, but does not provide biophysical membrane-binding measurements in this article.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: LTX-315-treated B16F1 cells release HMGB1 into supernatant, supporting immunogenic-cell-death/DAMP release context.
direct_assay_types: HMGB1 Western blot of lysate and supernatant fractions
mechanism_claims.limitations: HMGB1 release is shown as a representative blot; it supports DAMP release but not a full pathway dissection by itself.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Intratumoral LTX-315 treatment is associated with tumor necrosis, CD3-positive immune-cell infiltration, inflammatory cytokine induction, and protective rechallenge responses in B16 melanoma models.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: LTX-315-treated B16 melanoma tumors in C57BL/6 mice
